figurative_meaning_en: Character getting spoiled or corrupted at a young age
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ছেলেটা কাঁচাবাঁশে ঘুণ ধরা, এখন থেকেই খারাপ সঙ্গে মিশছে।
এই বয়সে কাঁচাবাঁশে ঘুণ ধরলে পরে সংশোধন করা কঠিন হয়।
example_sentences_in_english: His son has the worm in young bamboo; he's already mixing with bad company.
If the worm infests young bamboo at this age, it's hard to correct later.
note: The idiom draws from natural observation of bamboo decay in rural Bengal, symbolizing early moral decline.
